title: Requirements for a small software tool
purpose: Captures what the tool is for, who uses it, what it holds and what must be in the first version, so the build can start without a long back-and-forth.
intro: Answer for the tool you have in mind. Where a question does not fit, skip it and say why in the note box of a nearby question.

questions.text: In one sentence, what should the tool let someone do that is hard to do now?
questions.help: Name the person and the action, for example: let the person on the counter see what is in stock without walking to the store room.

questions.text: How is this job done today?
options: By hand, on paper or from memory
In another app that only half fits
It is not done at all

questions.text: What goes wrong with the current way?
options: The information ends up in several places
It cannot be done away from a desk
Nothing serious, it is just tedious

questions.text: How often will the job be done once the tool exists?
options: Rarely, but it matters when it happens

questions.text: Roughly how many minutes does one run of the job take now?
questions.help: A guess is fine. Say in the note what the guess is based on.

questions.text: Describe one concrete situation in which you would say the tool has paid for itself.
Will anyone other than you use it?
How many people will use it in total?
Do those people need to see each other's entries?
options: Some see everything, others only their own
No, each person sees only their own

questions.text: Where will it be used?
On the phone, which of these apply?
The people using it are comfortable working out new software without help.
Does it have to work with no internet connection?
What are the things it keeps track of? List them, one per line.
questions.help: For example: jobs, customers, parts, readings.

questions.text: About how many records will there be after a year?
Is there existing data to bring in?
options: Yes, in a spreadsheet or CSV file

questions.text: Will it hold any of these?
options: Names or contact details of people
Passwords or keys to other systems
Where people or equipment are located

questions.text: Which other tools or services must it exchange data with, if any?
How much would it matter if one day of entries were lost?
Put these in order, most important first.
List what it must do on day one. One per line.
List anything it should deliberately leave out.
Is there a date it is needed by?
options: Sooner is better, with no fixed date

questions.text: What is the date, and what happens on it?
How many hours a week can you set aside to help while it is built?
questions.help: Trying early versions and answering questions.

questions.text: What monthly running cost is acceptable?
options: More than 50 a month, if it earns its keep

questions.text: I already know exactly what I want this tool to do.
What has not been asked that the builder should know?
